units.source_text: 却说那空蝉态度过分冷淡，竟不像是这世间的人，

en.t: Now Utsusemi's manner was so excessively cold that she seemed hardly a person of this world,

units.source_text: 源氏公子每一念及，心中便想：

en.t: and whenever Prince Genji thought of it, he would say to himself:

units.source_text: “如果她的态度温顺些，那么就算我那夜犯了一次可悲的过失，也不妨从此决绝。

en.t: "If her manner had been a little more yielding, then even though I committed a regrettable fault that night, I could have broken with her from then on.

units.source_text: 但她态度那么强硬，教我就此退步，实在很不甘心。”

en.t: But with her attitude so unbending, it is truly hard for me to withdraw just like this."

units.source_text: 因此他始终没有忘记过她。

en.t: For that reason, he never forgot her.

units.source_text: 源氏公子先前对于像空蝉那样的平凡女子，并不关心。

en.t: Before this, Prince Genji had paid no attention to ordinary women like Utsusemi.

units.source_text: 自从那次听了雨夜品评之后，他很想看看各种等级的女子，

en.t: But since hearing that rainy-night discussion, he had wanted to see women of every rank,

units.source_text: 便更加广泛普遍地操心用思了。

en.t: and so he began to give his thoughts and attention to them far more widely.

units.source_text: 那个轩端荻大概还在天真地等待着他的好音吧，

en.t: That Nokiba no Ogi was probably still innocently waiting for good news from him,

units.source_text: 他想起了并非不觉得可怜。

en.t: and when he thought of her, he could not help feeling some pity.

units.source_text: 然而这件事如果被无情的空蝉知道了，他又觉得可耻。

en.t: Yet if heartless Utsusemi were to learn of this affair, he felt it would be shameful.

units.source_text: 因此他想先探实了空蝉的心情再说。

en.t: So he decided first to find out what Utsusemi truly felt.

units.source_text: 正当此时，那伊豫介从任地晋京来了。

en.t: Just then, the Iyo Assistant came up to the capital from his provincial post.

units.source_text: 他首先前来参见源氏公子。

en.t: The first thing he did was come to pay his respects to Prince Genji.

units.source_text: 他是乘海船来的，路途风霜，不免脸色带些黝黑，

en.t: He had come by sea, and after the hardships of the journey his face was inevitably somewhat darkened,

units.source_text: 形容有点憔悴，教人看了不快。

en.t: and his appearance was a little worn, giving an unpleasant impression to those who saw him.

units.source_text: 然而此人出身并不微贱，虽然年老，还是眉清目秀，仪容清整，迥非凡夫俗子可比。

en.t: Yet the man was by no means of low birth, and though he was old, his features were still handsome and his bearing neat and dignified, quite beyond comparison with ordinary vulgar men.

units.source_text: 谈起他那任地伊豫国，源氏公子本想问问他当地情况，

en.t: When the talk turned to his post in Iyo Province, Prince Genji wanted to ask him about conditions there,

units.source_text: 例如浴槽究竟有多少[\[10\]](#part1333.html#m10)等事。

en.t: such as exactly how many bath tubs there were[\[10\]](#part1333.html#m10), and other such matters.

units.source_text: 然而似乎无心对他讲这些，因为心中过意不去。

en.t: Yet he seemed to have no heart to speak of such things with him, because he felt guilty inside.

units.source_text: 他正在回忆种种事情。

en.t: He was in the midst of recalling all sorts of things.

units.source_text: 他想：“我对着这忠厚长者，胸中怀着此种念头，真是荒唐之极，惭愧之至！

en.t: He thought, "To face this honest elder while harboring such thoughts in my breast is utterly absurd and deeply shameful!

units.source_text: 这种恋爱真不应该！”

en.t: This kind of love truly should not be!"

units.source_text: 又想起那天左马头的劝谏，正是为此种行为而发的，

en.t: Then he remembered that the admonition from the Captain of the Left Stables that day had been directed precisely at conduct like this,

units.source_text: 便觉得对不起这个伊豫守。

en.t: and he felt he had wronged this Governor of Iyo.

units.source_text: 后来又想：“那空蝉对我冷酷无情，原属可恨；

en.t: Later he thought again, "That Utsusemi is cold and heartless toward me, and for that she is indeed hateful;

units.source_text: 但对丈夫伊豫守，她却是个忠贞多情的女子，令人佩服。”

en.t: but toward her husband, the Governor of Iyo, she is a faithful and deeply feeling woman, and that is admirable."
